title: Define cost model and establish a sourced baseline
question: What exact computation model, input/output contract and verified literature baseline will be used to evaluate the open factorization goal?
rationale: A precise baseline prevents timing results, special-case methods or randomized/conditional bounds from being mistaken for a general deterministic improvement.
next_action: Create a RUN, acquire remote TSK claim, then read the goal HYP report and collect primary baseline sources.
notes: Draft only; no execution or verification claimed.
success_criteria: Specify uniform deterministic classical bit model, memory access/allocation cost, arithmetic cost and complete factorization output encoding including multiplicities.
Preserve n = ceil(log2 N), and explain relation to binary input length at powers of two.
Find primary sources for known general-purpose bounds; distinguish unconditional deterministic, conditional, randomized and heuristic results.
Propose fair reproducibility, C17 reference implementation and proof/review criteria without claiming the ultimate bound.
Record unresolved source/model issues and actionable next task; independent review before integrating baseline decisions.
resource_limit: First research session: one investigator; literature/model scoping only; no parallel workers or long experiments until a budget is authorized.
